abort_conditions: Abort if the fixture manifest hash differs from the specified hash or any requested fixture ID is unavailable.
Abort if either arm resolves to a different model, backend, temperature, top_p, prompt, fixture bytes, or seed.
Abort immediately if any frontier call occurs or GPU usage reaches 10 minutes before all paired measurements complete.
Abort if any arm-fixture measurement or timing record is missing.

candidate.single_delta: On candidate evaluation calls only, select the existing critic_medium profile instead of critic_current; leave the model, prompts, fixtures, seed, and all other settings identical.

proposal.claim: Using the existing Qwen critic_medium profile for evaluation-only critic calls preserves decision accuracy on the balanced four-fixture critic subset while reducing median wall time by at least 10% versus critic_current.

guardrails: Use identical fixture bytes, model, backend, prompt construction, seed, temperature, and top_p in both arms; vary only reasoning_effort through the named profiles.
Record decision validity and end-to-end wall time for every arm-fixture pair before aggregation; count malformed or missing decisions as incorrect.
Do not alter production defaults, runtime configuration, schedulers, schemas, or call sites, and make no frontier calls.
experiment.pass_rule: Pass only if candidate critic_decision_accuracy is at least baseline accuracy, every output is evaluator-parseable, and candidate median end-to-end wall time is at least 10% lower than baseline.

proposal.falsifier: Falsify the upgrade if candidate accuracy is below baseline, any candidate output is malformed, or candidate median end-to-end wall time is not at least 10% lower under the paired controls.
proposal.title: Evaluate medium versus xhigh Qwen critic effort
